data.name: Afeer
data.gender_notes: Afeer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Afeer is derived from the word 'afara', which means 'to fly'. This name is given to a boy who is swift, agile, and strong, like an arrow that flies through the air with great force. The name Afeer carries the meaning “Flying arrow” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afeer usually hope their child will grow to embody flying arrow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the freedom of the soul to soar high and connect with the divine
data.etymology: Afeer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flying arrow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afeer total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عفير
in_arabic.meaning: عفيف و رقيق و لطيف و خالص
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عفير مشتق من الفعل عفر، و هو يعني التربة أو الطين الذي يلتصق بالشيء، و في بعض الأحيان يأتي بمعنى الشيء الخالص أو النقي، و قد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية أن العفير هو نوع من أنواع الطين في الجنة.

in_urdu.name: عفیر
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام عفير عربی زبان کے الفعل عفر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نرم اور لطیف، اور بعض اوقات خالص یا پاکیزہ بھی۔ اردو میں اس کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلم معاشروں میں ایک خوبصورت اور معانی سے بھرپور نام کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अफीर
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम अफीर का अर्थ है नर्म और लतिफ, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी उपयोग किया जाता है और इसे एक अच्छा और पवित्र नाम माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عفیر
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عفير نوم د عربی ژبې د عفر فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د نرم او لطيف معنی لري. په افغانستان کې، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولګيو کې یو ښکلی او معنوي نوم ګڼل کیږي.

As such, the name Afeer is a reflection of these qualities and is associated with ambition, determination, and a strong desire to excel in life.

The name Afeer also highlights the importance of obedience and submission to Allah, as these angels are a constant reminder of Allah's ultimate power and sovereignty. Ultimately, the name Afeer inspires us to be like the angels, striving for excellence in all that we do, while staying grounded in our faith and obedience to Allah.
